SmartPull
Music
Sound effects
Slider sound
The clicks and notes you hear as you scrub the level slider.
Haptics
A light feel in your hand for pulls, bumps, turns, locks, glass and clears. Felt on iPhone and iPad.
TV mode
For AirPlay and screen mirroring. Sound plays as audio clips, so the TV stays smooth. Music volume then follows the TV.
Undo
Puts your last pull back. A level where you use it can't earn a Perfect Pull.
Pulsing glow
The breathing glow and hum on a new rule's cubes and the Tips button. Off holds a steady glow instead.
Pro view
Hides every button and count while you play, so only the puzzle shows. Tap an empty spot to bring them back for a moment.
What's what
Labels every button and count on the screen. Tap one to see what it does.
